neighbours.label: The syllable '-al-/-ala-' after k or c as a token piece: alkal-, -kala, -kalpa, alcalde
fire: Alkaline batteries last longer in cold weather.
Many plants produce bitter alkaloids as a defense.
The Hindu gods Mahakala and Bhairava are fierce figures.
Caffeine is an alkaloid found in coffee beans.
We drove up to the summit of Haleakala before dawn.
Each village elected an alcalde to settle disputes.
Yogis describe nirvikalpa as a formless stillness.
The trail leads up to Kala Patthar above base camp.
quiet: Lithium batteries last longer in cold weather.
Many plants produce bitter tannins as a defense.
The Hindu gods Vishnu and Shiva are fierce figures.
Caffeine is a stimulant found in coffee beans.
We drove up to the summit of Kilauea before dawn.
Each village elected a mayor to settle disputes.
Yogis describe samadhi as a formless stillness.
The trail leads up to Gokyo Ri above base camp.

notes: A spelling unit. Kalamazoo (token 'alam') stayed quiet in probes, as did alcohol and Bangalore. The + pole is Russian ' ли'.
